ziplines_post_desc: A tall post with a pulley on top. Build two, press E on one and then on the other to run a rope between them, then press E to ride it.
ziplines_hover_ride: Ride to the other post ({0}, {1} m down)
ziplines_hover_bottom: The bottom of a line: it only runs downhill, so ride it from the other post ({0}, {1} m up)
ziplines_hover_lost: This line has lost its other end
ziplines_hover_run: Run the line here ({0} m from the other post)
ziplines_downhill_only: A zipline only runs downhill: ride this one from its other end.
ziplines_lost_end: This line has lost its other end: take it down (Shift+E) and run it again.
ziplines_not_ready: This post is not ready yet: try again in a moment.
ziplines_started: Line started: go to the other post and press E on it.
ziplines_has_line: This post already has a line.
ziplines_too_close: These posts are too close together for a line (8 m at least).
ziplines_too_far: Too far: a line can be {0} m long at most, this one would be {1} m.
ziplines_too_flat: A line has to run downhill: one post must be at least {0} m higher than the other for {1} m (it is {2} m). Build one on higher ground.
ziplines_joined: A line {0} m long runs between the posts. Press E on either one to ride it.
ziplines_post_not_ready: A post is not ready yet.
ziplines_need_axe: You need an axe to ride: hook it over the rope and hang from its handle.
ziplines_hammer_away: Put your hammer away to ride.
ziplines_drag: The line would drag along the ground {0} m from here. Make the posts higher, or the line shorter.
ziplines_in_way: Something is in the way {0} m along the line ({1}).
ziplines_server_missing: Ziplines isn't installed on this server, so zipline posts can't be built here.
